evidence: Cic. Sen. 83: nec vērō velim quasi dēcursō spatiō ā calce ad carcerēs revocārī (Lewis & Short s.v. spatium)
terms.comment: Literally “to be called back from the finishing line to the starting gates”. Traupman’s order is ad carcerēs ā calce revocārī.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
